generalSituation: A dry northeast monsoon is bringing generally fine weather to Guangdong. Locally, the relative humidity over the territory generally fell below 50 per cent around noon.
tcInfo: At noon, Severe Tropical Storm Champi was centred about 950 kilometres southwest of Kagoshima. It is forecast to move north-northeast at about 25 kilometres per hour across the East China Sea and weaken progressively.
forecastPeriod: Weather forecast for this afternoon and tonight
forecastDesc: It will be fine. Hot and very dry in the afternoon. Moderate northerly winds, occasionally fresh offshore.
outlook: Mainly fine and dry in the next couple of days. Windier and becoming cloudier gradually midweek next week.
